propositions: Infrastructure exceptions at gate sites must emit an additive `gate_error_v1` sidecar record with `verdict=ERROR` and error cause/evidence before the gate's existing outcome is returned or exception re-raised
Plan-review and code-review gates catch `LLMUnavailableError` and must write the ERROR record then return the existing degraded INDETERMINATE verdict
Completion gate must write the ERROR record then re-raise the `LLMUnavailableError` to preserve fail-closed behavior
The `gate_error_v1` schema is separate from verdict schemas and never routes through `reconcile_verdict` so ERROR verdict survives uncoerced
Domain BLOCK/FAIL outcomes (non-infra failures) must not write an ERROR record
Existing verdict readers must skip `gate_error_v1` records via schema guards so ERROR records are isolated from verdict-read consumers
